description: This program tests how operators combine with several Python operand and container types.

steps.description: The first loop tests + with integers, floats, strings, and lists. It prints a result or catches and reports TypeError.
The second loop tests *. The listed pairs include strings and lists with integers, plus two lists.

steps.answer: The page identifies list multiplied by list as the non-orthogonal failing case.
steps.question: Which listed multiplication pair raises TypeError?

steps.description: The comparison loop evaluates == across matching and different types without using exception handling.
Sets use | for union. The attempted set + set operation is caught as TypeError.
The final section tests dictionary merge with | and catches the failed dictionary + dictionary operation.

title: Probe Python orthogonality
